Alright, the latest test run showed that client A still isn’t seeing the remote player (A sees 0, B sees 1). My quick‑debug script confirmed that A’s internal state has no targets while B does, so the problem is definitely on the A side. I suspect the root cause is the way the multiplayer sync logic is being executed.

Looking back at the code, the sync was originally inside the main render loop (the requestAnimationFrame callback). That loop can be throttled or even paused when the tab isn’t in focus, which would prevent A from sending its state updates frequently enough for B to register it, especially right after the room is created. To address this, I moved the sync logic into a setInterval timer that runs independently of the rAF loop, ensuring consistent updates even if the tab is backgrounded. I also added a comment explaining why this change is necessary.

I applied two edits to `app/public/js/main.js`:
1. Replaced the original block that performed `net.lerpStates`, `net.getRenderList`, and periodic `net.sendState` inside the rAF loop with a new timer‑based implementation that tracks elapsed time (`lastNetT`) and only runs when the necessary conditions (`net && roomCode && game.player && game.mode === 'dm'`) are met.
2. Updated the comment near the map loading section to reflect that the multiplayer sync now runs on a timer, not the rAF loop.

Both edits were applied successfully, and the file is now up‑to‑date in the repository. The next step is to verify whether these changes actually fix the asymmetry. The most straightforward way is to rerun the full playtest suite (`node playtest.mjs`) and filter the output for any failing checks (lines containing the ✘ symbol) as well as the summary of passed checks. That will let me see instantly if the “both clients see each other” check now passes, without having to sift through a massive log.

Therefore, I’ll invoke a Bash command to run `node playtest.mjs`, pipe both stdout and stderr, and grep for the relevant markers. This will give a concise report of the current test status.
